summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: Package advertises itself as a PDF editor React library. The declared `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/`, writes it to a temp path, chmod 0o755's it, and then uses that freshly-downloaded alternate runtime to execute a bundled ~727KB obfuscated Bun-compiled script `math_init.js` shipped alongside. `math_init.js` carries a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header and heavy obfuscation (large rotated string/const array with a string-array rotator function; hex-style identifiers such as `WV8StW`, `n7gIxM`, `hc1jfK9`) — a shape unrelated to the advertised PDF-editor purpose. The alternate-runtime step is not a build-time toolchain fetch: Bun is dropped specifically to execute the sibling obfuscated bundle that the Node interpreter would not otherwise run, evading scanners that only inspect Node-executed code. Fires automatically on `npm install` via the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
